title: Scalar multiplication of circuit shares
statement: Let $F$ be a field with decidable equality, let $\iota$ be an input-index type, let $d\in\mathbb N$, let $R$ be a degree-$d$ resharer, and let $A$ be a finite set of parties. For every party-indexed input assignment $\mathrm{inp}$, scalar $c\in F$, and circuit $a$, the BGW evaluation of the circuit obtained by multiplying $a$ by $c$ assigns to each party $j$ the value $c$ times the BGW evaluation of $a$ at $j$.
hypotheses_covered: A is a finite set of parties
inp is a party-indexed input assignment
replaced:
Let $F$ be a field, let $a$ be an arithmetic circuit, and let $c\in F$. At every party,
BGW evaluation of the circuit obtained by multiplying $a$ by the public scalar $c$
equals $c$ times that party's BGW evaluation of $a$.
